S.FORM: alang Ulaljuc ga niya mki sku Heto Keng atu Taybu go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 225 buwan, 915 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 98% kyan ku 896 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 2% kyan ku 19 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Paywan 95%, Bunun 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli2%. rhzyal kki'an tay mkyahu' na Ulaljuc hya' ga Puljetji. tay 'zil na Ulaljuc hya' ga Qapedang. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy maki 1 pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy. pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ ulalju[ʦ|ʨ] ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku ħeto keŋ atu tajβu ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa pajwan ** βunun * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli* rħzjal kkiʔan taj mkjaħuʔ na ulalju[ʦ|ʨ] ħjaʔ ɣa puljetji taj ʔzil na ulalju[ʦ|ʨ] ħjaʔ ɣa qape*aŋ reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj maki * pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
